accept: rheumatic mitral stenosis found on screening

findings: Normal P waves or early left atrial enlargement

echoTasks.find: Thickened leaflets with diastolic doming of the anterior leaflet in long axis
Fish mouth orifice in true short axis avoiding oblique cuts that overstate separation
Rheumatic leaflets with an enlarged left atrium in the apical window

auscultation.added: Opening snap audible on careful auscultation
auscultation.murmur: Mid diastolic rumble grade 1 of 4 at the apex with the bell

exam.general: Healthy 22 year old woman, no distress, normal nutrition
exam.other: No oedema, lungs clear, no thrill
exam.precordium: Tapping apex beat of normal character

history.a: No breathlessness, no palpitation, detected at a college health camp
Fever with joint pains at age 11, treated, no follow up
Runs and climbs stairs normally with peers
Nursing student, understands the need for yearly echo

keyPoints: Start secondary prophylaxis with benzathine penicillin G 1.2 million units by intramuscular injection every 4 weeks, per the WHO rheumatic heart disease guidance
Schedule yearly echo with the same windows and measurements for comparability
Counsel on prompt reporting of breathlessness or palpitation and on endocarditis precautions
Optimise image quality with correct depth, focus and gain so the orifice planimetry is reproducible
Document the acquisition protocol order so follow up studies match this baseline
management.model: Secondary prophylaxis with protocolised yearly echo and image quality optimisation for comparable follow up

sources: WHO guidance on rheumatic fever and rheumatic heart disease, in own words
ASE guideline on valvular stenosis, in own words
stem: A 22 year old asymptomatic nursing student from Mysuru is found at a camp to have a loud first sound with a soft diastolic rumble.
teaching: Mild means area above 1.5 sq cm with gradient below 5 mmHg, and the valve stays pliable
The sonographer skill is a foreshortening free long axis and a true short axis for planimetry
Gain and focus discipline makes the orifice edge reproducible year to year
Every mild case starts prophylaxis with a dated surveillance protocol
title: Mild mitral stenosis found on camp screening
